summary: Decompresses one batch of Huffman-coded texture data from an input bitstream. Reinitializes through AudioBufferReset when the block-count field is set and the decode-state remaining-block counter is exhausted, then decodes up to this->0x13C sub-blocks into the output descriptor array at this->0x140, consulting three lookup globals, and persists the bitstream and Huffman decode state on exit.

operations.description: Reinitialize before the main pass when the block-count field (this+0xFC) is set and the decode-state struct at this+0x194 reports a zero remaining-block counter (v3[12]); abort the whole call when AudioBufferReset fails.
Load the input bitstream state from this+0x14 (saved bit accumulator and read pointer) and the stream offset at this+0x18, capturing the initial read pointer and offset for the decode pass.
Skip the sub-block decode loop when this+0x13C (number of sub-blocks to process) is not positive.
Stage the Huffman decode state held in the struct at this+0x194: bit accumulator (this+0x1A4), bit count (this+0x1A8), and intermediate values at this+0x1B4, this+0x1B8, this+0x1BC and this+0x1C0.

Iterate over up to this+0x13C sub-blocks, writing decoded output into the descriptor array at this+0x140, updating this+0x178 during processing, and decrementing the remaining-block counter at this+0x1C4.
HuffmanArithmeticBitstreamSymbolDecoder decodes each symbol from the bitstream within the loop.
sub_51A794 processes each decoded sub-block and is invoked inside the loop.
Read the decode lookup tables dword_5AF778, dword_5B03A0 and dword_5B03E0 while reconstructing each sub-block.
On exit, persist the bit accumulator and read pointer to this+0x14 and this+0x18 and the bit accumulator and bit count back to the decode-state struct at this+0x1A4 and this+0x1A8.
